given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner submits a Delivery Proof showing a package was damaged during transit
given_when_then.when: The system processes the delivery proof
given_when_then.then: A Dispute Ticket is automatically generated with status 'Open' and linked to the Order Request

given_when_then.given: A Customer reports a missing item and the system attempts to generate a Dispute Ticket
given_when_then.when: The system detects the delivery proof is missing or incomplete
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket with status 'Pending Investigation' and notifies the Customer

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner submits a Delivery Proof indicating a delivery exception
given_when_then.then: A Dispute Ticket is created immediately to record the nature of the issue

success_criteria: The Dispute Ticket is created immediately upon receipt of the Delivery Proof indicating a delivery exception.
The Dispute Ticket status is set to 'Open' when generated from a delivery exception.
The Dispute Ticket is linked to the original Order Request.
The system records the specific nature of the issue (missing items, damages, or failed deliveries) within the ticket.
